Hi Liam — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock a technical runthrough with our ML/infra folks.

Recap (1-min):
- Primary goal: validate throughput/latency targets for your multimodal ranking model and discuss secure data paths for inference.
- Success criteria: a sanity check run + checklist that identifies any blockers to a POC within 4–6 weeks.

Proposal (next meeting):
- Format: 60–90 minute hands-on runthrough (screen share, sample inference, infra requirements).
- Attendees we’ll bring: Marcus (infra), Lauren (model serving lead), Grace (CS/ops). Please let us know if you want anyone else from your side — engineering + security recommended.
- Agenda (suggested):
  1) 10m — goals & quick architecture review
  2) 25m — demo of a similar workload (latency/cost tradeoffs)
  3) 20m — run sample inference with your sequence lengths + look at KV/cache behavior
  4) 15–25m — Q&A, blockers, mutual action items

Three windows we can offer (PDT):
- Thu Jul 1 — 10:00–11:30
- Fri Jul 2 — 13:00–14:30
- Mon Jul 5 — 08:00–09:30

Prep asks for a smooth session:
- A short sample prompt or small anonymized dataset (S3 link or similar) we can use for the runthrough.
- Any networking constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlists) or compliance notes to surface ahead of time.

Attached: a lightweight mutual action plan template and our pre-call SRE checklist — we’ll fill in once you confirm a slot.

If any of those windows work, pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and owners.

Thanks,
Ben

Answers to your quick questions:
- Synthetic sample is fine for the runthrough. We prefer anonymized/sampled data so we can exercise sequence-length and tokenization paths without any privacy risk. If you do want to exercise production-like patterns, include representative sequence-lengths and batch size in a readme.
- Network prerequisites (summary):
  • IP allowlist: we’ll provide a short list of outbound IPs for the session (and notify you if we route through a temporary relay).
  • VPC peering: not required for the demo; optional for a later POC.
  • Ports: standard HTTPS (443) for all traffic; if you have an outbound proxy let us know.

Attachments: I’ve reattached the mutual action plan and the precall checklist. Also linking our HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-114

See you Friday — thanks for moving quickly on this.

—Ben
